item.text: The serializer joins fields with commas without CSV escaping. Contact names stay in one column because a separate workaround replaces their commas with semicolons, which conflicts with the README’s requirement to preserve customer text. I’ll use standard CSV quoting for all fields and remove that workaround.

item.text:
Fixed CRM-284 with standard CSV escaping. Companies such as `Acme, Inc` now remain in one field, keeping all four columns. Names such as `Doe, Jane` retain their commas instead of becoming semicolons.

Quotes, line breaks, and spreadsheet formula protection are covered. All five tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.
